tasks.title: Notify adopts contract 2.4.1 and proves parity with its own channel rules
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, R7 precondition, Test test/contract-parity.test.ts and all Completion evidence; Rollout step 3; Evidence R2/R3 table; Non-goals clientName cap; Security impact dependency pins; Acceptance evidence 4-5. Before editing, verify notify main pins 2.4.0 c5ce6685ce8b563a243823bca451032291b81adb from #810. If older (currently 9ab7e2492a2cec91789fba7c742bdba900a800a9), request a needs-input hold naming #810; if already 2.4.1 or later, hold because the change is already there. Preserve the native blocked-by #810 rollout dependency. Once ready, add a table-driven parity test first and record old-pin assertion failures, then bump only the manifest and lockfile to the shared full 2.4.1 main merge SHA. For every R2/R3 Evidence row, vary only from, to[0] or smtp.clientName on the base email fixture and compare channelSchema('email') safeParse success with validateNotifyChannelDefinition ok and the literal expected notify c79f0b7 boolean. Include actual NUL, whitespace, empty, CR/LF and all hostname/literal cases, including the 64-character label; omit 201..255-character clientName names because the contract keeps its 200 cap. Notify's own schemas/helpers and all src files remain unchanged.

acceptance.expected: Before implementation, @lorenzh/pulse-contract pins c5ce6685ce8b563a243823bca451032291b81adb from #810. An older pin triggers a needs-input hold naming #810; 2.4.1 or later triggers a hold because the change is already present.

On 2.4.1, 0 fail: every R2/R3 Evidence row produces the literal notify c79f0b7 boolean independently from notify and contract, with from and to[0] both covered. The bold old-contract discrepancies fail by assertion on c5ce668 before the bump; positive controls stay valid. The intentional 201..255-character cap disagreement is excluded. A focused run may fail only global coverage; its exit status is not the acceptance result.
exit 0; the updated dependency pin and lockfile agree.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass with the existing 80% line coverage gate.

package.json and bun.lock's workspace dependency contain the same full 40-character SHA of the merged pulse-contract main commit implementing R1-R6 (version 2.4.1), independently verified from that contract PR; the lockfile resolution matches that commit.
exit 0; notify's own rules and all production source remain unchanged.
Before committing, only package.json, bun.lock and the new test/contract-parity.test.ts are changed or untracked.
exit 0; required notify CI checks pass.

Records the #810 prerequisite, the parity rows that fail by assertion on 2.4.0 and pass on 2.4.1, both independent implementation results and literal booleans, the intentionally excluded 201..255-character cap difference, the independently verified merge SHA/lockfile, full checks and applicable Security impact dependency-pin review; src is unchanged.
